title: Distill joins feedback rows to their lookups and the store keeps them in closed fields only
goal: Distill joins each feedback row to its entry by pack handle, else by session and prompt id, else (a tools-file row) by the prompt window as other tools rows join, and a row that joins none becomes an entry of its own; the entry gains a 'feedback' field of closed values only (outcome, judged_by agent or user, lines with their issue class, best, source ids matched to _sources.csv, a lead url that passes the research candidate url gate (D-666asy3d), tool_issue); Haiku maps an unclassified comment to those classes and its text never reaches the store (D-rd64qovu); ql_store gates refuse a feedback field with free text, an unknown class, a line or best that is not a kb path, or an ungated url, each with one planted failure; the spool rows go once delivered, as other rows.

gates.question: What shape does an entry's feedback field have when several reports join one lookup (recommended: a list, because merging would lose which line a report judged and who judged it)
options: a list of 1 to 5 closed reports in time order
one object that merges the reports
gates.recommendation: a list of 1 to 5 closed reports in time order
gates.answer: a list of 1 to 5 closed reports in time order

gates.question: How does a spool feedback row say it is a person's report with a comment to map (the contract kb!: rows will follow)
options: judged_by user and a rule-redacted comment, mapped when the row has no outcome
a separate surface or an unclassified outcome value
gates.recommendation: judged_by user and a rule-redacted comment, mapped when the row has no outcome
gates.answer: judged_by user and a rule-redacted comment, mapped when the row has no outcome

gates.question: What does distill do with a feedback row that arrives after its lookup's entry was already written to the local store
options: the row becomes an entry of its own
the row is dropped, the stored entry is not rewritten
gates.recommendation: the row becomes an entry of its own
gates.answer: the row becomes an entry of its own

gates.question: When the Haiku mapping of a comment cannot run (no budget, a failed call), what happens to its entry
options: the entry waits in the spool for the next run
the entry is written without that report
gates.recommendation: the entry waits in the spool for the next run
gates.answer: the entry waits in the spool for the next run
